comment: Family substrings already covered by lib/model-registry.ts. The freshness watchdog flags popular HF models whose id matches none of these. Lowercase, matched against the full model id. INVARIANT: every coveredFamilies entry must appear in the registry, and the watchdog fails if it does not — so a family can never be silenced without also being documented.
aliasComment: Alternate repository naming for families already documented above. Exempt from the invariant because the name never appears in our prose — only in Hub repo ids.
